attribute_schema.title: Kolhapuri Chappal
attribute_schema.description: Hand-braided leather footwear from Kolhapur. GI 2019. Not a textile -- this category exists to demonstrate that the schema engine is category-agnostic, not Patola-specific.

tanning_method.description: Vegetable tanning is the traditional method and commands a premium.

sole_thickness_mm.description: Millimetres. A number, not an integer -- half-millimetre grades are normal.
